correctness_required: committed-state consistency evidence with explicit native observability limits
Every measured and warmup request completes exactly its frozen reference output-token count with length termination; reject early stopping and failed requests.
acceptance.decision_rule: Report point effects and intervals per source: useful point gain is ratio <= 0.95, material point regression is ratio >= 1.02. Label uncertainty explicitly; no automatic promotion or confirmatory pass with four blocks.
acceptance.numerical_scope: The separate pilot admission verifies complete BF16 duplicate weights and bindings for all48 MoE layers, exact logical/physical routing and token conservation in diagnostic cases, and native/FP32 expert arithmetic at layers0,23,47 under the previously fixed atol0.02/rtol0.03. It does not certify full-model logits, exact generated texts, semantic answer quality, or native asynchronous committed weights. Generated-token and output-length differences remain explicit in all comparisons; no post-pilot tolerance relaxation is permitted.

amendment.reason: User requested a fair equal-output-length comparison after the natural-EOS results.
amendment.statistical_scope: One group per workload, three arms; descriptive only, no confidence interval or reproducibility claim.

analysis.arrival_normalization_caveat: Each external source block is uniformly time-rescaled to that dataset's previously fixed OFF-based pilot rate. OFF, ON and custom share the resulting exact absolute calendar. Scaling preserves relative timing and timestamp ties but changes the original production rate; calibration is not a sustainable-capacity estimate, and these results do not establish behavior at other loads or authentic joint content/arrival distributions.
analysis.cross_source_dependence: Calendar dates and patterns are shared across sources; never pool sources or treat the 20 blocks as independent evidence for one universal effect.
analysis.estimand: Per-dataset paired treatment/baseline response ratios for this one group; no pooling.
analysis.experimental_unit: One reserved sixteen-request content group and its existing arrival calendar per dataset.
analysis.generation_caveat: Equal generated token count per prompt, not identical token sequence, expert routing, batching or mathematical answer quality.
analysis.multiplicity: No tests or confidence intervals; point margins are descriptive, not acceptance guarantees.
analysis.pilot_precision_limit: One completed pilot content/arrival block per source cannot estimate between-block variance or power. Four final blocks do not justify a confirmatory 5% gain or 2% regression guarantee.
analysis.primary_endpoint: mean full-response latency from scheduled arrival
analysis.timing_boundary: Primary request and replay timing charge online decision/feature/communication overhead and complete output drain. Startup, pilot warmup and shutdown are separately reported, excluded from warmed replay latency; no claim about deployment-total time.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive only: one group cannot estimate between-group or repeated-run variation.

custom.anticipated_control: No further recording/rebalance after resident initialization.
custom.anticipated_dispatch: One-home resident assignment using globally agreed routing; per-pair active-copy cap plus longest-processing-time assignment. Exact implementation and correctness evidence await integration admission.
custom.anticipated_physical_map_formula: For rank r in 0..7: [16*r + i for i in 0..15] followed by [16*(r XOR 1) + i for i in 0..3].
custom.anticipated_placement: Each EP rank r owns its 16 logical experts plus the first 4 experts of its paired neighbor (r XOR 1); four independent rank pairs, 160 physical slots and 32 redundant copies total.
custom.contrast_scope: Whole method: paired static placement plus resident dispatch plus disabled recurring control. Native ON retains its default initialization and async EPLB. Results cannot isolate dispatcher-only causality.
custom.placement_selection_basis: Static structural CPU feasibility, independent of final inputs or outcomes; uniform activation admits 16 active physical experts per rank within each pair.

equal_length_reference.freshness: Fresh server executions of previously used content and unchanged calendars; not fresh payloads or an independent generalization sample.
equal_length_reference.meaning: Equal generated token count per prompt, not identical token sequence, expert routing, batching or mathematical answer quality.
equal_length_reference.request_settings: Each request sends max_tokens=N, min_tokens=N, ignore_eos=true, stop=[], stop_token_ids=[]. All arms charge this common sampling/control overhead.
equal_length_reference.rule: Per-request target equals the previous natural-EOS OFF completion count. No speed-based selection. Pilot warmup00 counts are reused for both warmup passes; measured counts bind each of the same16 prompts.

execution.arm_order_rule: Reverse the previous fixed arm order in each workload before execution; no outcome-based order selection.
execution.budget_note: Six fresh server launches; previous startups take several minutes each. No shortening admitted work.
execution.cache_conditioning: Identical pilot warmup file, order and two-pass policy per dataset and arm; record cache hits, preemptions, graph/config/compiler/cache fingerprints; no final-informed prewarming.
execution.eplb_completion: HTTP drain or drain_async is not proof of committed weights; preserve normal-commit and rank-consistency diagnostics and any unresolved coverage.
execution.failure_policy: Retain all failures, halt on correctness failures, never select fastest attempts. Infrastructure-only retry must repeat the complete paired triple with unchanged hashes and use the first complete valid triple. No algorithm/rate/data changes after final freeze.
execution.initial_state: Fresh server/checkpoint and arm-defined placement before identical warmup; native ON may adapt its map during warmup as part of its treatment. Record this history; do not equate HTTP drain with EPLB commit.

warmup_diagnostics.pass_0: Prompt/output token IDs and selected-token logprobs requested
warmup_diagnostics.pass_1: Same 8 inputs without diagnostic logprobs/token-ID return; warm native execution shapes

execution.warmup_passes_status: Fixed before final admission: the same 8 pilot requests run twice per server, 16 warmup executions total.

native_arms.off: Unmodified vLLM, EPLB disabled, no redundant experts
native_arms.on: Unmodified vLLM, native async EPLB,32 redundant experts,default linear initial map; ordinary native intervals unchanged

scope.scope_limit: Two descriptive short full-model episodes, one group each; no repeated-run uncertainty or production-capacity claim.

workload_phase_check.limit: Request-phase dominance is not proof of GPU compute/bandwidth boundedness. Report any failure to achieve intended phase dominance.
workload_phase_check.rule: Classify each arm by its larger summed native request prefill/decode duration, with16 completed counts in each phase. No outcome-based retuning or replacement.
workload_phase_check.selection: First reserved group of each dataset, unchanged full prompts/calendar/rate; dataset and output-budget choice follows the user's phase-focused scope reduction, not final speed rankings.
